caption: The drawing shows a rectangular section with an ornamental pattern composed of repetitive floral and geometric shapes. The main area of the pattern consists of reddish-brown motifs set against a lighter brown background. The motifs alternate between square-like, symmetrical arrangements with interior dots and petal shapes, and clusters of stylized leaves and flowers. The pattern elements are evenly spaced and repeat in a regular grid. The design is contained within a rectangle centered on a larger, off-white sheet of paper. In the lower right margin of the paper, the name "A. MENÉNDEZ" is faintly written.
title: Wallpaper
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
